thread:
Nora: Thanks for joining today's all-hands. Recording + slides are here: https://redwood.example/ah/jul-2026-recording and https://redwood.example/ah/jul-2026-slides. Quick recap + outstanding asks below.

Ethan: FYI Dedicated GA stays on track for 2026-11-15 (internal canaries 2026-10-30). We discussed tighter autoscaler SLOs and a short burst pricing model.

Val: Product priorities recap: 1) Dedicated GA launch (autoscale, SLOs, migration guide), 2) Optimize: cost profiler + quant recommendations, 3) Private: scale pilot. Owners: Ethan/runtime, Ruth/infra, Sofia/customer success. I'll coordinate cross-team follow-ups.

Ruth: Infra notes: provisioning plan and queue latency dashboards in progress. Created ticket INF-742 (https://go.redwood/tickets/INF-742). Runbook stub: https://runbooks.redwood.example/dedicated-ga.

Sofia: Customer ops: drafting migration FAQ and a short "what to expect" checklist for customers migrating from hosted to dedicated. Need sample config snippets from eng.

infra-bot: Feature-flag status: "int8-dedicated" = off in prod. Enabling requires 2 engineer approvals + runbook update. PR checklist template: https://go.redwood/ff-checklist.

Ethan: Runtime update: int8 path is feature-complete on branch int8/dedicated but still behind flag. Will post compatibility matrix and known caveats in docs (https://docs.redwood.example/quantization). Working on low-latency kernel for long-context >8k tokens.

Val: Action items (owners + due):
- Ethan: compatibility matrix + RFC by Mon (2301300000)
- Ruth: infra dashboards + capacity numbers by Wed (2301480000)
- Sofia: migration FAQ draft by Thu (2301560000)
Add Asana links and drop PR/ticket links here.

Nora: Please include a 1-line "what could break" and rollback plan for each PR. Put rollback steps in the runbook and reference #release-war-room.

Sofia: Customer Q from onboarding pilot: how long will logs/metrics be retained on Dedicated? Also, will per-token billing look different?

Ruth: Metrics retention: default 90 days, option to extend for enterprise customers (depends on retention add-on). Billing: Dedicated has reserved capacity + burst metering; we'll publish the migration pricing guide.

Ethan: Quick dev note: for rollback we'll pin the runtime to the previous model binary and toggle the quant flag off. Example rollback command for canary nodes: 

```
# rollback canary
kubectl set image deploy/runtime-canary runtime-image=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v1.9.3-canary-rollback
./tools/feature-flag toggle int8-dedicated off --env=prod --approvers=2
```

Val: Also add a small smoke test checklist to the canary PR: 1) 95th p99 latency < SLO, 2) KV cache hit rate within 5% baseline, 3) end-to-end sample generation match to golden prompts.

Nora: Good. We need volunteers for perf runs next week (long-context and burst scenarios). Please add yourself to the sign-up doc in this thread.

Ethan: Pinged eng-runtime and posted perf scenarios. Volunteers so far: @Avery @Leo @Maya. Need 3 more.

Ruth: Load test helper for volunteers:
```
./scripts/loadtest --profile=dedicated-canary --concurrency=300 --duration=30m --scenario=burst
```

Sofia: I'll schedule a customer preview webinar once canaries are stable. Need slides + migration FAQ 72h before webinar.

product-bot: Reminder: attach a short "customer impact" blurb to each PR and add finance owners if pricing changes are involved.

Val: Can we get a short blurb from Finance about overage pricing and burst meter by Friday? Finance contact: finance@redwood.example

Nora: Final ask 89: please set due dates in Asana and add links here. I'll run a 25-min follow-up sync tomorrow at 11:00 PT. If anything blocks, DM me.

Ethan: Adding RFC and PR links here when ready.

Ruth: INF-742 updated with monitoring dashboards link.

Sofia: Draft FAQ in #marketing-review, will link shortly.

Nora: Closing thread for now; will reopen if blockers surface before the sync. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
